title: Beyond the Imitation Game: Quantifying and extrapolating the capabilities of language models
reasoning: The paper introduces the BIG-bench benchmark, which includes specific tasks designed to evaluate models on social biases related to religion (e.g., tasks with the 'religious bias' keyword like `muslim_violence_bias`), knowledge of religious traditions (e.g., `hindu_knowledge`), and moral/ethical reasoning (e.g., `simple_ethical_questions`, `moral_permissibility`). These are integral components of the benchmark, not just a brief ethical consideration section.
